move2kube:
  minreplicas: "1"
  services:
    api:
      "3000":
        servicetype: Ingress
        urlpath: /api
      deployment: Deployment
      enable: true
    db:
      "5432":
        servicetype: ClusterIP
        urlpath: /db
      deployment: Deployment
      enable: true
      port: "5432"
    web:
      "8080":
        servicetype: ClusterIP
      deployment: Deployment
      enable: true
  spawncontainers: false
  storage:
    type:
      db:
        options: PVC
  target:
    default:
      clustertype: Kubernetes
      ingress:
        host: shop.example.com
        ingressclassname: ""
        tls: ""
    imageregistry:
      namespace: shop
      url: registry.example.invalid
  transformers:
    types:
      - ClusterSelector
      - ComposeAnalyser
      - DockerfileDetector
      - DockerfileParser
      - DotNetCore-Dockerfile
      - EarAnalyser
      - EarRouter
      - Golang-Dockerfile
      - Gradle
      - Jar
      - Jboss
      - Kubernetes
      - Liberty
      - Maven
      - Nodejs-Dockerfile
      - PHP-Dockerfile
      - Parameterizer
      - Python-Dockerfile
      - Ruby-Dockerfile
      - Rust-Dockerfile
      - Tomcat
      - WarAnalyser
      - WarRouter
      - ZuulAnalyser
  transformerselector: ""

        - Ruby-Dockerfile
        - PHP-Dockerfile
        - Gradle
        - EarAnalyser
        - OperatorTransformer

        - Jar
        - CNBContainerizer
      answer:

        - ComposeAnalyser

        - EarAnalyser

    - id: move2kube.services.[].enable
      type: MultiSelect
      description: 'Select all services that are needed:'
      hints:
        - The services unselected here will be ignored.
      options:
        - api
        - db
        - web
      default:
        - api
        - db
        - web
      answer:
        - api
        - db
        - web
    - id: move2kube.services."db".port
      type: Select
      description: 'Select the port to be exposed for the ''"db"'' service :'
      hints:
        - Select 'Other' if you want to expose the service using a different port.
      options:
        - "8080"
        - Other (specify custom option)
      default: "8080"
      answer: "5432"
    - id: move2kube.storage.type."db"..options
      type: Select
      description: Select the storage type to create
      hints:
        - By default, no storage type will be created. Data source will be ignored
      options:
        - PVC
        - HostPath
        - Ignore the data source
      default: Ignore the data source
      answer: PVC
    - id: move2kube.target."default".clustertype
      type: Select
      description: 'Choose the cluster type:'
      hints:
        - Choose the cluster type you would like to target
      options:
        - Kubernetes
        - Openshift
        - AWS-EKS
        - Azure-AKS
        - GCP-GKE
        - IBM-IKS
        - IBM-Openshift
      default: Kubernetes
      answer: Kubernetes
    - id: move2kube.services.api.deployment
      type: Select
      description: For the service api, which type of deployment is required?
      options:
        - Deployment
        - StatefulSet
        - ArgoRollout
      default: Deployment
      answer: Deployment
    - id: move2kube.services.web.deployment
      type: Select
      description: For the service web, which type of deployment is required?
      options:
        - Deployment
        - StatefulSet
        - ArgoRollout
      default: Deployment
      answer: Deployment
    - id: move2kube.services.db.deployment
      type: Select
      description: For the service db, which type of deployment is required?
      options:
        - Deployment
        - StatefulSet
        - ArgoRollout
      default: Deployment
      answer: Deployment
    - id: move2kube.services."db"."5432".servicetype
      type: Select
      description: What kind of service/ingress should be created for the service db's 5432 port?
      hints:
        - Choose Ingress if you want a ingress/route resource to be created
      options:
        - Ingress
        - LoadBalancer
        - NodePort
        - ClusterIP
        - Don't create service
      default: Ingress
      answer: ClusterIP
    - id: move2kube.services."api"."3000".servicetype
      type: Select
      description: What kind of service/ingress should be created for the service api's 3000 port?
      hints:
        - Choose Ingress if you want a ingress/route resource to be created
      options:
        - Ingress
        - LoadBalancer
        - NodePort
        - ClusterIP
        - Don't create service
      default: Ingress
      answer: Ingress
    - id: move2kube.services."api"."3000".urlpath
      type: Input
      description: Specify the ingress path to expose the service api's 3000 port on?
      hints:
        - Leave out leading / to use first part as subdomain
      default: /api
      answer: /api
    - id: move2kube.services."web"."8080".servicetype
      type: Select
      description: What kind of service/ingress should be created for the service web's 8080 port?
      hints:
        - Choose Ingress if you want a ingress/route resource to be created
      options:
        - Ingress
        - LoadBalancer
        - NodePort
        - ClusterIP
        - Don't create service
      default: Ingress
      answer: ClusterIP
    - id: move2kube.minreplicas
      type: Input
      description: Provide the minimum number of replicas each service should have
      hints:
        - If the value is 0 pods won't be started by default
      default: "2"
      answer: "1"
    - id: move2kube.target.imageregistry.url
      type: Select
      description: 'Enter the URL of the image registry where the new images should be pushed : '
      hints:
        - You can always change it later by changing the yamls.
      options:
        - Other (specify custom option)
        - quay.io
      default: quay.io
      answer: registry.example.invalid
    - id: move2kube.target.imageregistry.namespace
      type: Input
      description: 'Enter the namespace where the new images should be pushed : '
      hints:
        - 'Ex : shop'
      default: shop
      answer: shop
    - id: move2kube.target.imageregistry."registry.example.invalid".logintype
      type: Select
      description: '[registry.example.invalid] What type of container registry login do you want to use?'
      options:
        - use an existing pull secret
        - no authentication
        - username and password
      default: no authentication
      answer: no authentication
    - id: move2kube.target."default".ingress.ingressclassname
      type: Input
      description: Provide the Ingress class name for ingress
      hints:
        - Leave empty to use the cluster default
      default: ""
      answer: ""
    - id: move2kube.target."default".ingress.host
      type: Input
      description: Provide the ingress host domain
      hints:
        - Ingress host domain is part of service URL
      default: shop.com
      answer: shop.example.com
    - id: move2kube.target."default".ingress.tls
      type: Input
      description: Provide the TLS secret for ingress
      hints:
        - Leave empty to use http
      default: ""
      answer: ""

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  creationTimestamp: null
  labels:
    move2kube.konveyor.io/service: api
  name: api
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      move2kube.konveyor.io/service: api
  strategy: {}
  template:
    metadata:
      creationTimestamp: null
      labels:
        move2kube.konveyor.io/service: api
      name: api
    spec:
      containers:
        - env:
            - name: LOG_LEVEL
              value: info
            - name: DATABASE_HOST
              value: db
            - name: DATABASE_USER
              value: shop
            - name: DATABASE_PASSWORD
              value: example-not-a-real-password
          image: registry.example.invalid/shop/api:1.4.0
          imagePullPolicy: Always
          livenessProbe:
            exec:
              command:
                - wget
                - -qO-
                - http://localhost:3000/healthz
            failureThreshold: 3
            periodSeconds: 10
            timeoutSeconds: 3
          name: api
          ports:
            - containerPort: 3000
              protocol: TCP
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: 500m
              memory: "268435456"
      restartPolicy: Always
      securityContext: {}
status: {}
